title: Denies the configured fields in clippy.toml
summary: Some fields are undesirable in certain contexts, and it’s beneficial to lint for them as needed. Clippy puts this lint in the style group, at the level warn.

title: Denies the configured macros in clippy.toml
summary: Some macros are undesirable in certain contexts, and it’s beneficial to lint for them as needed. Clippy puts this lint in the style group, at the level warn.

title: Denies the configured methods and functions in clippy.toml
summary: Some methods are undesirable in certain contexts, and it’s beneficial to lint for them as needed. Clippy puts this lint in the style group, at the level warn.

title: Checks for usage of disallowed names for variables, such as foo.
summary: These names are usually placeholder names and should be avoided. Clippy puts this lint in the style group, at the level warn.

title: Checks for usage of unicode scripts other than those explicitly allowed by the lint config.
summary: It may be not desired to have many different scripts for identifiers in the codebase. Clippy puts this lint in the restriction group, at the level allow.

title: Denies the configured types in clippy.toml.
summary: Some types are undesirable in certain contexts. Clippy puts this lint in the style group, at the level warn.

title: Checks for diverging calls that are not match arms or statements.
summary: It is often confusing to read. In addition, the sub-expression evaluation order for Rust is not well documented. Clippy puts this lint in the complexity group, at the level warn.
